am saddened to write this because the surgery has been excellent in the past. But there was some confusion over an on line prescription. East Boldon pharmacy didn't have the prescribed tablets but they did have an alternative. I needed my tablets urgently because of a forthcoming holiday so the chemist kindly emailed the surgery and asked them to change the prescription and asked me to give them a ring as a follow up request, which I did. Unfortunately I was told by the receptionist to go and pick the prescription up at the chemist and try a few more chemists in the area, and if after trying a few, I couldn't manage to find the required drug to ring the surgery back and a revised prescription would then be issued.
I have never ever had to do this in the past. But according to this receptionist it was her way of working and it had never been done any other way in the past.
Just as well I have my husband available as I have had two spine operations and can have some very bad days when I'm bed ridden.
